gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically documented glioblastomas or anaplastic astrocytoma prior to the debulking surgery that is suspicious to have progressed on imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary goal of this Phase I study is to determine the maximum tolerated dose of oncolytic adenovirus mediated double suicide-gene therapy in combination with fractionated stereotactic radiosurgery
This treatment is combined with a combination of oral 5-fluorocytosine (5-FC) and valganciclovir (vGCV) prodrug therapy.

candidate_flag.reason: 5-fluorocytosine and valganciclovir are antitumour prodrugs activated by the suicide genes and given to every patient; coded as backbone of the gene-therapy system, but could be read as pharmacological candidates.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with radiologic evidence of intracranial recurrence or progression of a previously diagnosed high-grade astrocytoma.
